title: Site questions apply as typed: a blank Name keeps the template's name, a description in another language than the site's is not put up as typed, ticked pages that share a slug stay, and a Joomla write over 1500 lines lands in parts
steps: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set as in the tracy-web suite, from apps/tracy-web run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/brief-brand.test.mjs test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs test/brief-about-language.test.mjs test/brief-wp-kept-pages.test.mjs test/joomla-contract-parts.test.mjs
Read the ok/not ok line of each test named in run.tests, and the fail count.
expect: 'D1 createSiteBrand: only a name the customer gave turns the site name on in Joomla page titles' is ok: a name from the site address (nameFrom label) or the template's own (nameFrom template) writes nothing, {}.
'a description given or a name from the site address renames nothing (D9)' is ok: with Name from the site address and About blank, neither home.text.eyebrow nor identity.name is written.

'a Vietnamese description does not stand as typed on an English site, and does on a Vietnamese one' is ok: aboutInLanguage('Tiệm bánh gia đình ở Dubai…', 'en-us') is false, the same text on 'vi-vn' is true, 'A family bakery in Hanoi.' on 'vi-vn' is false.
'two pages sharing a slug are told apart by their path: the unticked one goes, its ticked namesake stays' is ok.
'3200 lines are written in three parts of at most 1500, each read again before it is written' is ok: three writes of at most 1500 lines, an inspect before each.
'a line one part refuses is set aside by name; the other parts are still written' is ok.
Every other test of the five files stays ok.

selectors.name: nameAnswered and withTemplateName in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/shared.js; brand.js, wordpress.js, joomla.js and emdash.js read them
selectors.language: aboutInLanguage in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/shared.js; wordpress.js drops the tagline and hero.paragraph inputs when it is false

evidence: Site questions check on the local stand, 12-13/10/2026 (tasks/evidence/site-questions-2026-10-13/): Name blank with About given named JA Essence WP and JA Impact WP after their address; a Vietnamese About on an English JA Impact WP stood under the English <title>; JA Impact WP's ticked /category/blog answered 404 beside an unticked namesake; JA Kinetic Joomla refused a 3,200-line write (more than 1500 slots).
fence: The real brief engines over a scratch Postgres schema with model and CMS doubles. Not exercised: a running CMS (covered by the local-stand runs in the evidence folder).

tests: D1 createSiteBrand: only a name the customer gave turns the site name on in Joomla page titles
a description given or a name from the site address renames nothing (D9)
a Vietnamese description does not stand as typed on an English site, and does on a Vietnamese one
other scripts the same way; plain Latin text, or nothing, stands anywhere
two pages sharing a slug are told apart by their path: the unticked one goes, its ticked namesake stays
3200 lines are written in three parts of at most 1500, each read again before it is written
a line one part refuses is set aside by name; the other parts are still written
a plan within one write is written once, as before
